The evidence is mostly speeches, appointments, IMF/World Bank-linked reform packages, and crisis responses.","evidence":[{"title":"DR Congo president appoints country’s first female prime minister","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/","summary":"Tshisekedi’s appointment of Judith Suminwa, a planning minister and technocrat, shows a concrete governing choice in favor of coalition management and competence. This is evidence of an executive program that can be evaluated against later staffing and policy execution.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.9","7B.8"]},{"title":"RDC: Minister of Finance gets a technocrat","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://acp.cd/economie/rdc-fwamba-likunde-un-technocrate-rompu-a-la-tete-du-ministere-des-finances-par-elysee-kakese/","summary":"The finance portfolio was given to a career public-finance technocrat. That reveals a technocratic fiscal direction rather than pure patronage, and it is measurable against subsequent budget and IMF performance.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.9","7B.8"]},{"title":"Programme de désarmement et démobilisation: une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"P-DDRCS is an explicit stabilization and state-authority program. This is one of the clearest revealed-goal statements in 2024: demobilize armed actors, restore state authority, and lower conflict risk.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"DRC IMF reaches agreement on ECF and RSF","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/11/13/pr-24416-drc-imf-reaches-agreement-on-ecf-and-rsf","summary":"The IMF package was framed around inclusive growth, governance, transparency, tighter spending-chain controls, and anti-capture reforms. This is a concrete economic program that can be tested against later execution, not just rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8","7B.7","7B.9"]},{"title":"Le Chef de l’État a assisté à l’ouverture de la session extraordinaire du conseil supérieur de la Cour des comptes","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-10-07","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_assiste_a_louverture_de_la_session_extraordinaire_du_conseil_superieur_de_la_cour_des_comptes","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly backed the Court of Accounts’ control function, and the court said his support helped revive anti-corruption oversight. This is a revealed institutional preference for oversight and public-finance discipline.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.9","7B.7"]},{"title":"Democratic Republic of Congo: Expanding and equipping primary school classrooms for better learning outcomes","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-02-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/02/28/democratic-republic-of-congo-afe-expanding-and-equipping-primary-school-classrooms-for-better-learning-outcomes","summary":"The education project emphasized merit-based teacher recruitment, stronger information systems, decentralized planning, and support for girls and students with disabilities. That reveals a concrete service-delivery and administrative-capacity direction.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8","7B.9"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la RDC: les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Salva Kiir appellent au respect des accords de paix","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-03-25","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au-respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly called for relaunching the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability. This is a clear strategic direction toward negotiation and de-escalation.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.5","7B.8"]},{"title":"Face à la presse: le Président Félix Tshisekedi a peint un tableau d’espoir de la RDC","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-02-23","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/face_a_la_presse_le_president_felix_tshisekedi_a_peint_un_tableau_despoir_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi emphasized a major military buildup and a force-forward approach to eastern insecurity. This reveals a second, more coercive strategic line, which later actions can be judged against.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.5","7B.8"]},{"title":"Army disarray hobbles Congo’s fight with Rwanda-backed rebels, officers say","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-04","url":"https://d2233.cms.socastsrm.com/2024/07/04/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/","summary":"Reuters reported Tshisekedi threatened to declare war against Rwanda while relying on proxy forces. This is a revealed security strategy, but it is coercive and inconsistent with the more diplomatic line elsewhere.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8","7B.9"]},{"title":"Congo President Tshisekedi draws criticism over constitutional reform plans","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-24","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-president-tshisekedi-draws-criticism-over-constitutional-reform-plans-2024-10-24/","summary":"Tshisekedi launched a constitutional review process that critics said could remove term limits and open the door to a third term. This is the clearest revealed goal for regime control and power preservation.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"DR Congo President Tshisekedi must use second term to tackle human rights crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/drc-president-tshisekedi-must-use-second-term-to-tackle-human-rights-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty said Tshisekedi made many human-rights pledges but little to no progress followed, while public resources were squandered and essential services underfunded. This is evidence that the promised program was weakly implemented or not candidly matched to capacity.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.10","7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"DRC: President Felix Tshisekedi must be held accountable for human rights violations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/","summary":"Amnesty says the state of siege concentrated power in military and police officials and was used alongside a crackdown on dissent. That points to a strategic direction centered on coercive control, not a transparent governing ideology.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.7","7B.10"]},{"title":"Congo election commission overspent, awarded opaque contracts- report","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-15","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-election-commission-overspent-awarded-opaque-contracts-report-2024-01-15/","summary":"A civil-society report said CENI could not account for about $400 million and used opaque procurement. This is evidence of disordered public administration and unclear governance priorities, not a cleanly articulated reform program.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.9","7B.10"]}]}
